Omega De Ville Prestige 40mm: blue leather at $5,100 or green steel at $5,500?

Both are 40mm steel references from the same collection. Ref 434.13.40.20.03.001 (blue dial, leather strap) lists at $5,100. Ref 434.10.40.20.10.001 (green dial, steel bracelet) lists at $5,500.

Both US prices are from omegawatches.com, checked 21 Nov 2026, so they are on the same basis. The gap is $400, about 8%.

Our take: the strap or bracelet is the real choice here, not the price.

Which would you wear, A or B? Comment below.

Source: Omega (omegawatches.com), US list prices, 21 Nov 2026. Retailer prices may differ.
